title: WhyMDM entry
description: One Apple MDM or DDM error code or status value, explained in plain English.

domain.description: Error domain as the device reports it (for example MCInstallationErrorDomain), or a WhyMDM pseudo-domain such as MDMCommandStatus.

code.description: Numeric error code, or a string value for status-style entries.

symbol.description: Identifier used for this code in a cited source, if any.

summary.description: What the code means, in our own words.

checks.description: What an admin should check or try next.

platforms.description: Platforms where this has been seen or documented.

confidence.description: apple-documented: Apple's documentation states it. observed: seen on real devices, with a public source. reported: stated by a third-party source. inferred: reasoned from the name or context. name-only: only the identifier is known so far.

sources.description: Where the information comes from. Link, don't copy.

last_confirmed.description: Latest OS version where this was confirmed, for example "iOS 26.1".
